+## Scientific invariants to retain
+
+Use c_v for the R1 JSON symbol c, which is per-particle heat capacity, not light speed. N counts thermal particles, not translational degrees of freedom; keep k_B. Na,Ta,c_v,D=Na+deltaN,E=c_v Na Ta+Q+W are positive on the main domain. Temperature is E/(c_v D), not heat divided by a fixed particle count.
+
+Preserve r0=Ua-c_v Na Ta, r_bal=Ub-Ua-Q-W, rN=Nb-D and aggregate rE=r0+r_bal=Ub-E. Do not add r0 twice. Preserve saved fine-stock and separately stored electron endpoint residuals. The existing coarse thermal-electron coordinate duplicates continuum, so saved-count assembly must not overwrite raw electrons_initial/final with continuum values.
+
+Keep atomic/hidden binding, fast energy, gas Q, geometry W, ambient/retained/escaping photon stores separate. W is already integrated; no second adiabatic factor and no integrated-event 1/H. Convert second-segment increments per V1 to V0 with R01, including product-rule tangent terms. A box bound is not a sharp physical range without attainability. None is not zero.
+
+Matched U,N and EOS can determine temperature without a separate nb, but native25 abundance normalization needs its own matched nb. The actual BASS bath/EOS remains unsupplied; physical temperature/native25/radii stay null. BASS208's endpoint-interpolated model must not silently replace frozen BASS205. CR111's 100 K density 8750/47 m^-3 is not this recipient. HE angular-coincidence checks do not supply a caloric or stopping provider. +# Finite thermal endpoint continuation handoff
+

Last content checkpoint before this metadata: 3aab941e9a54a3184c90d68902c619f044846054. Base was 53dea7d4a3d0621908053c81b1eb462cec39abab. No merge or original-DAG modification was performed.

+## Result and incomplete work
+
+New unit finite_thermal_endpoint_20261028 now has R1-R5 5/10 and C1-C4 design 4/10, combined 9/20. This is partial completion of the requested full theory/coding loop, not a 20/20 result. Evidence is DERIVED with same-context checking, not independent validation.

+## Scientific invariants to retain
+
+Use c_v for the R1 JSON symbol c, which is per-particle heat capacity, not light speed. N counts thermal particles, not translational degrees of freedom; keep k_B. Na,Ta,c_v,D=Na+deltaN,E=c_v Na Ta+Q+W are positive on the main domain. Temperature is E/(c_v D), not heat divided by a fixed particle count.
+
+Preserve r0=Ua-c_v Na Ta, r_bal=Ub-Ua-Q-W, rN=Nb-D and aggregate rE=r0+r_bal=Ub-E. Do not add r0 twice. Preserve saved fine-stock and separately stored electron endpoint residuals. The existing coarse thermal-electron coordinate duplicates continuum, so saved-count assembly must not overwrite raw electrons_initial/final with continuum values.

Convert second-segment increments per V1 to V0 with R01, including product-rule tangent terms. A box bound is not a sharp physical range without attainability. None is not zero.
